purpose: Acquire and no-return screen one daily CCASS clearing-participant breadth-change factor for the fixed three-local-session A-share protocol without participant identities, holding quantities or ratios, prices, returns, or credential persistence.

provider_contract.documented_availability: source trade-date data is loaded before 09:00 on the next trading day
provider_contract.request_mode: one completed local trading session per count-unknown paginated partition
provider_contract.pagination_offsets: 0, 5000, 10000, 15000; stop only after a page shorter than 5000; four full pages are fatal before another request
nonretryable_failures: invalid target A-share key or participant count

identity_and_schema_policy.source_trade_date: strict eight-digit YYYYMMDD string equal to the requested completed local session
identity_and_schema_policy.source_code: complete string; supported A-share codes are six digits with SH or SZ suffix and are mapped to Qlib SH/SZ prefix; complete unsupported codes are excluded and counted
identity_and_schema_policy.participant_count: finite strictly positive base-ten integer; boolean, missing, nonfinite, fractional, zero, negative, signed, exponent, or decorated strings are fatal for a supported target row
identity_and_schema_policy.page_identity_uniqueness: every full trade_date/ts_code source identity must be unique across all pages of one requested session before board filtering
identity_and_schema_policy.target_identity_uniqueness: every normalized trade_date/instrument key must be globally unique

factor.name: tushare_ccass_participant_breadth_change_3
factor.missing_current_prior_or_intermediate_se: missing factor; never fill or shorten the lookback

point_in_time_policy.source_trade_date_label: the clearing-position date reported by Tushare
point_in_time_policy.availability: before 09:00 on the next local trading session as documented by the provider
point_in_time_policy.signal_label: source trade-date close for the fixed next-open protocol
point_in_time_policy.earliest_entry: next local trading session open after the source trade date
point_in_time_policy.calendar: the exact frozen local Qlib day calendar

normalized_acceptance_snapshot.factor_values: derived and checked in memory for the four anchor sessions but not persisted in the source-count snapshot

required_checks: the mechanism audit, contract, source and holding universes, local calendar, quarterly quality, price-basis context, frontier, latest terminal record, and both execution policies match before Token access or network access
only Token presence is checked; the credential value is never logged, persisted, hashed, or returned
all sixteen fixed completed local sessions are requested in chronological order with exact fields and count-unknown 5000-row offset pagination
every requested session ends on a short page, every source identity is unique across pages, and no unsupported code or raw response is persisted
every supported A-share row has the requested date, a point-in-time source-universe identity, and one strict positive integer participant count
every anchor proves Shanghai-main, Shenzhen-main, and ChiNext transport; the latest anchor additionally proves STAR transport
each anchor has at least twenty point-in-time holding names present on all four sessions, at least two distinct finite three-session changes, and at least one nonzero change
the exact t over t-minus-three-local-session formula is independently reproducible in memory without open, close, price, return, market cap, holding quantity, ownership ratio, or participant identity
the published snapshot has only four frozen columns and contains all accepted source-count rows from the sixteen sessions
acceptance_protocol.one_shot_policy: The exact acceptance may publish at most one success or rejection manifest. Once any provider request is issued, an entitlement, empty-session, schema, identity, pagination, coverage, board, continuity, or variation failure consumes the attempt. Every clone must reject a second attempt from the tracked result before loading this contract, Token, local context, or network.

full_snapshot_contract_after_acceptance_.provider_partition: one local trading session with the same pagination and field contract
full_snapshot_contract_after_acceptance_.atomic_publish: one hidden temporary root; publish seven annual four-column source-count Parquet partitions and one manifest only after every session and source gate passes

no_return_gates_after_full_source_only.statistical_rule: for every dense comparison with at least 100 pairwise-valid sessions and at least 50 names per session, absolute median daily Spearman correlation must be below 0.8; sparse neighbors remain mandatory semantic reviews with their observed overlap reported

future_return_protocol_boundary.required_before_any_open_close_or_forwar: one accepted source record, one separately frozen fingerprint-bound full-source/no-return protocol, one successful atomic 2019-2025 source snapshot, one passed capacity audit, one passed semantic and statistical uniqueness audit, and one new immutable single-factor diagnostic preregistration
